notes.title: Shizume's Intro
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the first story of Echo Tokyo Intro has now been completed and fully tested and includes:
[list]
[*]6,000 word story introducing Shizume
[*]80 unlockable images
[*]Full voice-acting of every line.
 - Includes, narration, speech and thoughts.
[*]5 Achievements to enjoy.
[*]Several choices that alter the story.
[/list]

In addition the original graphic light novel is available to purchase separately, this has its own version of the story written by a separate writer in prose rather than in the game format. The DLC will be available to purchase on release alongside the main title.

tags.feature: - Several choices that alter the story.
